# Awesome Game Assets

> A bilingual directory of game assets and production tools with source links and license notes. This repository does not distribute third-party assets or grant a universal commercial-use license.

## Browse
- [English overview](README.md): representative packs and category navigation.
- [中文入口](README.zh-CN.md): 精选素材和分类导航。
- [Complete catalog](docs/catalog.md): all entries, source pages and license notes.
- [完整中文目录](docs/catalog.zh-CN.md): 全量条目、来源和许可。

## Reuse and maintenance
- [Selection and preview rights](docs/discovery.md): editorial ordering, unknown popularity and media boundaries.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): dataset and verification workflow.
- [List license](LICENSE): CC0 for the list text, not every linked asset.
- [Risk warnings](WARNING.md): sources to avoid, not recommendations.
